qualification: deterministic original-store fixtures plus human-owned isolated enrollment persistence; paid inference remains unverified
proved: Exact private enrollment directory, generation, profile, computed service, account and credential command before HOME override
Original canonical lifecycle checked before the first private credential read
Default and legacy command HOME unchanged
Original exclusive enrollment add, selected account, and deletion paths
Canceled physical replacement write retains exact uncancelled settlement ownership
Recreated credential owner uses the same canonical enrollment binding
Second enrollment skips only already verified fresh accounts during legacy migration
Revoked execution, deleted or changed generation, foreign service and replaced directory refuse
notExecuted: Agent-initiated OS security or Keychain commands

humanOwnedEnrollment.profile: V1 / QA1, original independent-signin bundle and retained account stores
humanOwnedEnrollment.userReported: Sign-in completed; Authentication remains signed in after refresh

journal.correlationLimit: Command observer publishes phase and exit code only; session/call/tool/message/task identifiers are unavailable

humanOwnedEnrollment.scope: Actual application enrollment wrote and reread its owned Keychain item. Model catalog and physical inference qualification are separate.

limitations: Missing owned enrollment directory fails closed, including credential deletion
The isolated QA profile requires a preserved trusted constructor option on restart
Successful isolated persistence does not establish provider model availability or paid inference
